features.reason: Typed ordered Line/Arc/Close construction with stable guide and endpoint identities.
Normalizes to validated ResolvedProfile2D without flattening or backend syntax branches.
Path-derived Profiles use the ordinary Compose operand dictionary and exact section-stack path.
Named ProfileSegments/Loop selection is supported; selection is not arbitrary path traversal.
Expansion precedes binding; fixture retains specialization and input provenance.
No common typed semantic-reference value spans Concept IR, Recognize, Forge, Modify, and AnalysisIR.
Recognize exposes exact face refs for replacement/inspection, not Profile-capable semantic values.
Native and canonical imported bounded domains, exact planar constraints, traction, force, and pressure work.
Curved weak constraints, nonlinear mechanics, contact, and dynamics are future formulations.
Analytic supports, planar holes/bands, Hyperbola and sampled non-rational B-spline trims, STL and OBJ; no NURBS support surfaces.
BRep exact topology and CIR occupancy dual-lower from shared constructive intent; SDF is a CIR backend.
Arbitrary BRep-to-CIR and CIR/SDF-to-exact-BRep are not assumed.
Typed Template invocation, artifact validation, imported resources, and deterministic provenance.
Trusted explicitly registered capabilities, one construct output, bounded standard prism or validated ExactBrep.
Multi-body/general loft/nested host Record/source generator/plugin discovery are not production features.
Exact shell executes but curved-trim certified volume envelopes remain release-loose.
